answer: Asymmetric Packet Latency Validation maps geographic routing paths across a decentralized ocean of participating nodes to catch fraudulent agent clusters. When duplicate agents attempt parallel queries, the system measures microsecond timing jitter and unexpected payload shaping as data crosses a designated processing river. Attackers scaling synthetic identities must pay substantial hardware rental fees to lease diverse physical server racks, turning the registration process into an economic walnut that breaks under distributed bandwidth inspection costs.
